statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Delayed NQ has re-extended close to the overnight high after the prior-hour pullback, while oil near $100 and fresh Middle East escalation keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold because meaningful overnight retracement has occurred and current cross-asset confirmation is not uniformly aligned despite renewed high-end retention.
headline: NQ re-extends toward the overnight high as Middle East escalation keeps Stress extreme
body: At 04:59:45 UTC, delayed NQ was 29,612.75 versus a 29,500.75 overnight open and 29,625.50 high. The prior published hour recorded 29,583.25, so the latest quote is a re-extension after visible repair rather than an uninterrupted one-way path. Brent is near $99.5 amid fresh regional escalation. Shared Finviz context is stale and excluded.

sources.title: Reuters — Oil heads for $100, Asia stocks subdued as Middle East tensions escalate

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, published Tail ranged from 16% to 32%. The peak was 32% during the September 8 14:00 UTC downside extension. Overnight Tail later rose to 24% as NQ advanced, then eased to 21% in the 04:00 UTC hour when a meaningful pullback appeared.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is WATCH because NQ has re-extended toward its overnight high after a prior-hour pullback, while the path still shows meaningful repair. Immediate high-retention risk is concentrated through 06:30 UTC; later WATCH checkpoints surround the U.S. cash open, Employer Costs at 14:00 UTC, and the Apple event at 17:00 UTC.
